dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Thanks for such an enjoyable time. I'm all pumped up now! I'm sure it'll be all smooth sailing for my research from here on out!

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: I've lost the game and made no progress in my research. Ugh... What should I do!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I found this.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Huh? Up on the mountain? Let me take a look...

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Wow, what a find! This is a priceless treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Treasure...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Treasure!?

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: ...A treasure trove of knowledge for the history enthusiast, I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Once, on a research trip, I read some ancient historical annals.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: I remember one of them, from before the time of the Knights of Favonius, talked about a team sent by the aristocrats to investigate the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: For some reason, though, the annals provide next to no details about what the investigation team found...

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: If this is one of the journals kept by that investigation team, it will serve as an immensely valuable historical source for researchers.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Would you be willing to go back into the mountains and see if you can find any more of them?

response.speaker: Stevens
response.text: Really? Thank you ever so much!

response.speaker: Stevens
response.text: Based on what I'm reading here... The team investigated three sites in total.

response.speaker: Stevens
response.text: One of them was where you found this — so that leaves two more.

response.speaker: Stevens
response.text: Let me see... here, and... here. I've marked them out on your map.

response.speaker: Stevens
response.text: Thank you for agreeing to this, and please be careful out there!

response.speaker: Stevens
response.text: Haha, in terms of material wealth... I can't guarantee there will be.

response.speaker: Stevens
response.text: But for helping me, I will make sure to provide you with compensation of a suitably material nature. A reward for your great contribution to academic research.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About those journals...

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: You found the rest of them? Amazing! Here, let me take a look...

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Hmm... Wow, my goodness... Wait, if this detail is correct...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What have you found out?

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Oh, uh... Sorry, I was lost in thought. Ahem.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Thank you, these investigation journals are of rather significant historical value. There is a serious dearth of detail on this topic in the existing literature, as all the available sources only make passing reference to some mysterious investigation team formed once by the aristocrats...

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: These journals you found will help fill in some major gaps in the historical record.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Now, we finally have answers to the questions of why so little information on the investigation appears elsewhere — and why nothing of relevance beyond the initial departure of the team is recorded in the annals.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think I understand what happened, too.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Yes, well... Although there are still a fair few minor details to straighten out, the overall picture is becoming very clear.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Paimon doesn't get it!

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Well, all the evidence — or lack thereof — would suggest that not one member of the investigation returned to Mondstadt. But, these journals suggest there's a chance that one of them, called Eberhart, may have managed to escape...

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Since there is no record of his return in Mondstadt, however... The million-Mora question is: Where did he go?

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Many other details need corroborating, too...

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: But without a doubt, this doesn't detract from how valuable these are as historical sources.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: I am most grateful to you. Please take this for your trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Any other books you find while out exploring the mountains, I'd be much obliged if you could bring them to me on your return.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Eberhart... Where did you go...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you gained anything from your trip so far?

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Ugh, don't get me started. Iris is far too busy, so I've had to scale the mountain myself... Almost lost my life in the process, never mind finding any ancient texts.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: But I wouldn't say that I gained nothing from all this. I did find some other things, such as this crown.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: My guess is that this was left behind by those who once wanted to conquer Dragonspine. One can only wonder as to the trials and tribulations they must have encountered.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: ...I fear we can only discover a few things about the past through these relics...

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Ugh, sorry, I'm rambling... I've already gleaned all I could from this item. From the looks of you, you must be an adventurer, so why don't you take this with you?

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Don't stand on ceremony — it's no use to me anyway, and what's more, I may require your assistance in the future, too.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only someone could help me out... Oh, sorry, didn't mean to be talking to myself like that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Well, here's how it is: I'm a researcher specializing in ancient history...

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Thanks to Ms. Iris, I received and read a truly enlightening document recently.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: She found it here on Dragonspine, and I believe that the mountain must be home to more lost texts...

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: If we had more of them, I would definitely make progress in my research.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Never mind weapons or ancient currency, these texts are the true treasure here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I'll leave you to it.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Be careful, this is an uncannily perilous place.
